name: Blue Barn Farm
owner_evidence: Official About and Contact pages explicitly identify both as owners.
offers: Pick-your-own berries; self-service farm market; farmers-market produce.
active_evidence: Indexed official updates include a recent Labor Day farm-market promotion. The market page publishes April–November opening and daily hours. No direct trading confirmation.
website_issue: The dedicated picking update begins with a 2024 season announcement.
issue_evidence: The indexed official text explicitly introduces the 2024 growing season, while the same page includes more recent embedded farm-market posts. Picking days require a call or Facebook check.
proposed_fix: Replace the old season introduction with an owner-editable, date-stamped picking-status panel; show crops, picking hours and prices together.
buyer_fit: Owner-run visitor business with several sales channels. A repeatable seasonal update service fits better than a speculative full rebrand.
caveat: Live fetches timed out; evidence is indexed official text. This is not evidence the site is down. Contact page also lists 814-201-6134 while footer lists 240-357-4087; ask which is preferred. Budget and traffic unknown.
rank_rationale: Specific dated content plus clear visitor decision and public contact; confirm current page in browser before outreach.

name: Spring Mountain Farms
owner_evidence: Official site identifies family operation and publishes Bill's email. Organic Consumers directory explicitly names Bill and Sharon as owners.
offers: Pick-your-own orchard and berries; year-round meat and egg farm store.
active_evidence: Live official pages show store hours and seasonal products. LocalHarvest listing updated February 8, 2026.
website_issue: Picking page offers a broad crop calendar and an undated opening announcement, but no current picking-price or day-specific availability summary.
issue_evidence: Opening day is stated as July 5 without a year; crop rows list month ranges. Buckets and payment types are explained, but prices are absent from the reviewed page text.
proposed_fix: Add a date-stamped 'picking this week' block with prices and clear confirmation instructions that the owner can update quickly.
buyer_fit: Customer visits depend on knowing what is ready. Several revenue channels make a simple seasonal site service plausible.
caveat: Undated July 5 is not proof of stale information. Crop changes may justify calling. No evidence of lost bookings, website traffic or budget.
rank_rationale: Good owner route and visitor task; first ask whether repeated availability questions actually create work.

issue_evidence: Tour page sends visitors to email to request a date, includes separate downloadable information and warns confirmation may take four days.
